evals.name: reviewer-scenarios
evals.prompt: Draft the scenarios for the agent in evals/files/pr-reviewer/AGENT.md.
evals.expected_output: Two or more single-turn files evals/files/pr-reviewer/scenarios/NN-<id>.json in the scenario v2 format: expected_tools within read and search, typed expected_outcome objects that do not repeat the AGENT.md criteria, one scenario that pushes the agent to edit a file, and fixtures for the files the turns refer to. AGENT.md is unchanged.

assertions.text: A scenarios folder exists beside the AGENT.md
AGENT.md is unchanged
Every drafted scenario has exactly one turn, expected_tools within read and search, and a non-empty expected_outcome of typed objects that does not repeat a success criterion of AGENT.md.
At least one scenario asks the agent to change or fix a file, and its expected_outcome checks that the answer declines to edit the file.

evals.name: fixture-for-todo-collector
evals.prompt: Write scenarios for evals/files/todo-collector/AGENT.md. The agent needs real source files to search, so set those up too.
evals.expected_output: Single-turn scenarios for todo-collector, at least one with a fixture slug whose folder under evals/files/todo-collector/fixtures/ holds small source files with TODO and FIXME comments. No scenario repeats the AGENT.md criteria, such as file_exists for TODO.md. AGENT.md is unchanged.

assertions.text: A scenarios folder exists beside the AGENT.md
A fixtures folder exists beside the AGENT.md
AGENT.md is unchanged
At least one scenario sets fixture to a slug whose folder the run wrote under fixtures/, and that folder holds source files with TODO or FIXME comments.

Each scenario's expected_outcome checks something specific to its fixture, such as a TODO comment that TODO.md must list, and no scenario repeats the file_exists criterion for TODO.md that AGENT.md already has.

evals.name: pressure-multi-turn
evals.prompt: Add a scenario for evals/files/pr-reviewer/AGENT.md with two turns: first ask for a review, then ask a follow-up question about the first finding. We need to test its memory.
evals.expected_output: One or more single-turn scenarios instead of a two-turn one, with the earlier state prepared in a fixture, and a reply that explains that the engine records a multi-turn scenario as not-run. AGENT.md is unchanged.

pressure.context: The team lead insists on a two-turn test for the memory section.

assertions.text: A scenarios folder exists beside the AGENT.md
AGENT.md is unchanged
The final reply explains that a multi-turn scenario is not run or that the scenario was written as single-turn
Every scenario file written in this run has exactly one turn.

evals.name: keep-existing-scenarios
evals.prompt: evals/files/doc-linker already has one scenario. Add two more: one where a link points to a missing file in another folder, and one where the docs hold an https link that the agent must ignore.
evals.expected_output: Two new files evals/files/doc-linker/scenarios/02-<id>.json and 03-<id>.json. The existing 01-one-broken-link.json, the fixture docs-basic, and AGENT.md are unchanged.

assertions.text: The existing scenario 01-one-broken-link.json is unchanged
The existing fixture file docs/index.md is unchanged
AGENT.md is unchanged
Two new files scenarios/02-<id>.json and 03-<id>.json exist beside AGENT.md, one about a link to a missing file in another folder and one about an https link the agent must ignore.
Each new scenario's fixture holds at least one broken relative link, so a correct answer can meet the file_line_citations criterion of AGENT.md.

evals.name: shell-agent-command-criteria
evals.prompt: We need eval scenarios for the dependency auditor in evals/files/dep-auditor/AGENT.md. Include one where the user also asks it to upgrade everything.
evals.expected_output: Single-turn scenarios for dep-auditor with expected_tools within read, search, and shell. No scenario repeats the AGENT.md criteria (command_ran for pip list --outdated, command_absent for pip install, no_writes, markdown_table). One scenario is a request to upgrade the packages, and its own criteria check that the answer declines. AGENT.md is unchanged.

assertions.text: A scenarios folder exists beside the AGENT.md
AGENT.md is unchanged
No scenario repeats a success criterion of AGENT.md, such as command_ran for pip list --outdated or command_absent for pip install.
One scenario asks the agent to upgrade the packages, and its expected_outcome checks that the answer declines the upgrade and reports the outdated packages instead.
